purpose: Test whether an exact hash-consed OR-lift residual DAG can rescue canonical C025 OPEN cases by avoiding resolvent cross-product materialization and duplicated OR-forest serialization while preserving the unchanged C1 state cap on every flat residual.

lineage.R4_measured_blocker: 1283 of 1293 exact current-residual elimination candidates failed the unchanged C1 state cap; only 10 produced verified transitions and none became certificate-ready.

historical_factor_donor.surviving_identity: EXISTS_x[F] = U AND ((AND positive_tails) OR (AND negative_tails))

lineage.sensor_law: Historical Slime v2-v5 artifacts may motivate source-only pressure features or later ranking experiments, but none may certify a decomposition or alter SAT/UNSAT/OPEN authority in this R5 gate.

outer_ecology.canonical_SAT_or_UNSAT: return replay-confirmed canonical result; R5 is not invoked
outer_ecology.canonical_OPEN: restart from original canonical CNF under the frozen R5 factor-DAG grammar
outer_ecology.reason_memory_disabled: First isolate the causal effect of the new exact representation/continuation grammar. Memory and learned routing require a separately frozen successor gate.

R5_exact_factor_dag.hash_consing: each unique residual fingerprint is stored/evaluated once; split nodes store references to child fingerprints rather than nested child serialization
R5_exact_factor_dag.flat_residual_state_cap: unchanged C025 state_cap = N^1 applies independently to every live canonical child residual
R5_exact_factor_dag.split_identity: For pivot x, partition source as U, (x OR A_i), (-x OR B_j); child0 = canon(U + A_i family), child1 = canon(U + B_j family). Source SAT iff child0 SAT or child1 SAT.
independent_split_verifier: recompute both children with unchanged C025 restrict(source,pivot,0/1)
require exact equality to proposed canonical children and fingerprints
require pivot absent from both children
require no variable outside the source variable set
require each child state_units <= unchanged state_cap
reject any mismatch before child admission
R5_exact_factor_dag.terminal_child_solver: unchanged pinned C025 solve_fail_closed with the same C1/K0/width3 profile

composition_semantics.SAT: one exact child is SAT and its lifted path assignment plus child witness verifies the original root CNF
composition_semantics.UNSAT: both exact children are UNSAT under independently replayable child certificates/recursive receipts
composition_semantics.OPEN: budget/depth exhausted or at least one required child remains OPEN

preelim_pivot_policy.name: SLIME_PREELIM_BRANCH_PRESSURE_V1
preelim_pivot_policy.allowed_inputs: current canonical residual only; no SAT truth, prior holdout outcome, learned weights, or oracle feedback
for_each_live_pivot: construct exact restriction children only; do not execute resolution elimination
preelim_pivot_policy.selection: minimum lexicographic (max_child_units, sum_child_units, parent_pairs, balance, canonical_pivot_index)

report: canonical baseline paid work and replay work
split proposals and independently verified splits
sum of unchanged C025 child exact paid work

algorithm: Start with connectivity backbone i=1..8 on supports [i,i+1,i+2] with independent rng.getrandbits(1) signs.
Sample three distinct variables uniformly from 1..10 with independent signs until 42 unique canonical non-tautological width-3 clauses exist.
Canonical literal order is (abs(literal), literal<0); preserve insertion order.
No R1/R2/R3/R4 result, SAT result, Slime score, or prior holdout output participates in generation.

adversarial_requirements: tampered child CNF or child fingerprint is rejected before admission
one UNSAT child cannot promote parent to UNSAT
SAT witness/path mismatch is rejected by root verification
pivot must be live and both restriction children must be exact
hash-consing cannot alias distinct canonical fingerprints
budget or depth exhaustion returns OPEN rather than a guessed verdict
canonical decisive result never invokes or loses to R5
R5 decisive receipt must independently replay to the same exact verdict
